_note: Instagram Reel overlay for the life-advice channel. All three use the bundled Montserrat Bold font and share the same per-post highlight color. The brand tag may use at most 2 lines at its fixed 46px; shorten wording rather than shrinking it. The topic sits below the subject's face and directly above the caption prompt. The numbered statement is 42px white text with per-line highlight boxes. Rendered as one static overlay held for the whole typing clip; the advice lives in the caption. The statement must fit 3 lines at its fixed 42px. If it wraps past that, shorten the wording rather than shrinking it. The caption prompt is 50px and sits at y=1450. See instagram/style_guide.md for approved pairings.
